title: Midwives and Holy Family Convent school
summary: Born at home with a midwife; school at Holy Family Convent, which was also an orphanage.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Right at home. Midwives, you know. What? Granny women, he called them. Yeah. Thank you. Um, you went to school at a Catholic school? Yes. St. Mary's—it is now St. Mary's Academy, but it was named the Holy Family Convent, you know. Mm-hmm. And whenever my grandmother had asthma, we'd stay there until she got well. They'd keep us there, and it was an orphanage as well as a boarding school.
So, I imagine your brother would have gone to a Catholic school, too.
Oh, I'm sure. He must have gone to one, but I don't know anything about his life, you know. Yes, I know.
I understand. I hate to keep just annoying with all those questions, but I just thought in case you'd heard somebody else say something about the—
